text: Our survey on remote sensing vision-language models was accepted by **IEEE GRSM**.
A collaborative paper on image restoration was accepted by **IEEE TGRS**.
A collaborative paper on semi-supervised change detection was accepted by **IEEE JSTARS**.
Our paper on spatial awareness for UAVs was accepted by **IEEE IGARSS (Oral)**.
Our paper on visual grounding in UAV imagery was accepted by the **ISPRS Congress**.
A collaborative paper on oriented object detection was accepted by **CVPR**.
We released the **Awesome Remote Sensing Vision-Language Datasets** project.
Our paper on implicit-to-explicit chain-of-thought in UAV imagery, **DVGBench**, was accepted by **ISPRS JPRS**.
A collaborative paper on oriented object detection was accepted by **AAAI**.
Our paper on multimodal mathematical reasoning in aerial vehicle imagery, **AVI-Math**, was accepted by **ISPRS JPRS**.
We won second place in the Large Model Adversarial Challenge of the **QiZhi Cup (启智杯)**.
A collaborative paper on cloud removal was accepted by **IEEE JSTARS**.
